experiment: two-inverter ensemble on the eta=0 features
question: does pairing a second inverter with SD 1.4 break scheme C's family bond?
protocol: the two inverters' (T=20,4,32,32) tensors are concatenated on the channel axis into (T=20,8,32,32); same skeleton widened to 8 channels, same hyperparameters, trained on the sdv1.4 training split (60k) and evaluated on all eight generators

inverters.note: SD 2.1 was the intended second inverter but every stabilityai/* repository is gated (anonymous access returns 401). SD 1.5 is a continuation of 1.4, so the two inverters are the SAME family -- this bounds what the experiment can show.

summary.note: sdv4/sdv5/wukong are Stable-Diffusion-derived; adm/biggan/glide/midjourney/vqdm are not

observations: SD family is unchanged: 78.9% vs 78.8% for the single inverter -- a same-family second inverter adds no information there
non-SD generators move from 49.5% to 52.7% on average, and biggan's inversion softens (39.8% -> 45.5%), but everything stays near chance
the SD1.5-only control matches SD1.4-only on sdv4/sdv5 (78.7/78.7 vs 78.5/79.2), confirming the two inverters see the same thing

the experiment cannot test the actual hypothesis: both inverters are Stable Diffusion. A genuinely different family (pixel-space ADM, or a GAN inverter) would be required, and the gated stabilityai repositories blocked the intended SD 2.1 arm
